title: G.p.i.
html_source:
Abbreviation for “general paresis of the insane,” a polite medical term for syphilis.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: A technical description of a certain stage of syphilis, where there is damage to the brain and consequently altered behaviour. It’s not really polite, it’s just the term.
